verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Payroll documents an automated hire-and-onboard flow that starts from the offer letter, and it lets ops users upload and store documents in each employee's profile. Neither source mentions sending documents for e-signature or signing them. missing for 10: explicit e-signature capability for offer letters and HR documents, evidence that signed documents are filed automatically to the employee profile, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can send offer letters and HR documents for e-signature and keep them stored per employee

citations.quote: Hire and onboard in one professional flow. From offer letter to day one, everything can be automated so new hires are ready to go.
Securely upload and store employee documents within individual employee profiles.
